agents.name: Signal Hunter
agents.asks: Find sourced capex, plant, tender, RFP, hiring, funding, and approval signals on this account only.

agents.name: Opportunity Intelligence
agents.asks: What might they buy, what triggered it, and whether a contract is actually implied. Do not invent a value.

agents.name: Account & Contract Qualification
agents.asks: Score the opportunity against the client mandate. Leave value unknown when no sourced figure exists.

agents.name: Buying Committee
agents.asks: Map who could control the award. Name only sourced people. Mark EPC and procurement as unknown when not sourced.

agents.name: Access & Outreach
agents.asks: Recommend warm path, targeted note, or hold. Do not invent an email. Nothing is sent.

agents.name: Contract Pursuit
agents.asks: Name the current stage and the next human action. Do not skip to award.
